frame_checksum: FNV-1a 32 over R, G, B of every light in layout order

fixed30.note: frame i: t = i / 30, dt = 0 for frame 0 and 1 / 30 after

jitter.note: frame 0: t = 0, dt = 0; frame i: dt = dts[(i - 1) % len] (num / den), t = t(i - 1) + dt

inputs.std: keys: (i * 37 + 11) % 103 when i % 7 == 3; (i * 13) % 103 and (i * 29 + 5) % 103 when i > 0 and i % 23 == 0. On the key layout they are keyPresses, plus pressAt [[0.25, 0.5], [0.8, 0.1]] when i % 31 == 17; on zone layouts they are pressAt [PH16_71[k].x, PH16_71[k].y], plus keyPresses [0, n - 1] when i % 31 == 17. audioBands and audioLevel from createSimAudio({bands: 20}) at t (the case's "bands" instead of 20 where it has one); clock (4 + i * 3 / 20) % 24.
inputs.quiet: no input at all (frame(t, dt) with input undefined)
inputs.nobands: std with audioBands an empty array (audioLevel kept)
inputs.sparse: std, but the only presses are key (i * 37 + 11) % 103 when i % 60 == 3 (keyPresses on the key layout, pressAt [PH16_71[k].x, PH16_71[k].y] on zone layouts), so an event can run its course before another one replaces it

case_layouts: [layout, byte offset in file, guard hits after the last frame, kind]; at the offset: frames x u32 checksum, then the first and the last frame, lights x 3 bytes each. A case with a stride keeps the checksums of frames 0, stride, 2 stride, ... only (ceil(frames / stride) of them)
